metaDescription: Photo booth hire in Wellingborough, Rushden and Earls Barton for weddings, proms and parties. Attendant, props and prints included. Request a quote today.
h1: Photo Booth Hire Wellingborough and the Surrounding Towns
intro: Whether your celebration is in a Wellingborough hotel, a golf club near Rushden or a barn outside Earls Barton, our photo booth hire service brings everything needed for a lively night. A friendly attendant runs the booth, guests leave with prints or digital copies, and the whole thing is built and tested before anyone arrives.

sections.heading: Matching the booth to the room in Wellingborough
paragraphs: Wedding couples in Wellingborough often come to us asking for the Magic Mirror, and it suits the town's barns and hotel function rooms well. Guests tap the full-length screen, play along with the animations and walk away with a print, while the guest book fills up beside it. Where a hotel suite has generous floor space and a high ceiling, the Inflatable Booth makes a glowing centrepiece for up to ten people, lit in a colour that matches the theme.

Company events lean towards the GIF Booth, which skips printing altogether and sends animated clips by email or QR code with your branding on each one. For birthdays in community centres and leavers' parties in school halls, the LCD SlimPod keeps things simple and affordable, with packages from £239.

sections.heading: Rushden, Raunds, Earls Barton and the rest of our patch
paragraphs: Wellingborough is one of the main towns of Northamptonshire, and we cover it alongside the smaller towns and villages that surround it. Rushden and Higham Ferrers lie to the south-east, Irthlingborough and Raunds to the east, Finedon to the north-east and Earls Barton to the west, on the way towards Northampton. Events in any of these places are part of our everyday work, not special trips.

The A45 links the town with Northampton and the eastern towns, the A509 runs through the area and the A6 serves Rushden and Higham Ferrers. Guests travelling from further afield can arrive by train at Wellingborough station on the Midland Main Line.

sections.heading: A planner's checklist for each type of occasion
paragraphs: Weddings: plan for the booth to open after the wedding breakfast and run into the evening reception, and share your colour scheme so the print template and props feel part of the day. Proms: schools usually want their crest on every print and a firm finish time agreed with staff, so send both early.

Corporate events and Christmas parties: send your logo and brand colours so we can prepare an overlay proof for approval, and let us know if staff will need digital copies emailed the same night. Birthdays: a themed design and props picked for the age being celebrated make the photos feel personal. Whatever the occasion, our reviews are rated 5 stars on Trustpilot.

sections.heading: Function rooms, fairways and farm barns
paragraphs: The rooms we set up in around Wellingborough fall into a few familiar groups. Hotels host many of the weddings and office parties, often with a dedicated function suite and easy access from the car park. Golf clubs are popular for milestone birthdays, retirement parties and smaller weddings, and community centres take care of christenings, family parties and charity nights.

School halls are the usual setting for proms and summer fairs, while village halls in places like Finedon and Earls Barton keep the local party calendar busy. Barns in the countryside around the town attract couples who want a relaxed, rustic wedding with room to dance.

sections.heading: Before we arrive: roads, doors and power
paragraphs: We time our arrival so the 45 to 60 minute build is finished before your hire window opens, and that setup time is never charged. Most Wellingborough venues have parking right by the entrance, which makes unloading quick. If a hotel asks us to use a rear door or service corridor, we follow its instructions and move the vehicle once the kit is inside.

A single standard socket powers every booth except the Inflatable Booth, which needs two. Rooms on an upper floor are fine for the slimmer booths, but please tell us about stairs and lifts at booking. For barns, a photo of the socket positions and the route from the yard to the door helps, and for village halls it is worth checking what time the key holder will open up.

faqs.q: Is there space to park and unload at Wellingborough venues?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Hotels, golf clubs and community centres in and around Wellingborough normally have a car park beside the function room. We unload at the closest door, carry the booth in and move the vehicle. If parking is restricted, give us the venue contact and we will arrange a time to unload.

faqs.q: Can you bring a booth up stairs to a first-floor room?
faqs.a: Yes, as long as we know beforehand. The LCD SlimPod, GIF Booth, Retro Pod and Selfie Mirror Pod are easy for two people to carry. The Magic Mirror, Party Booth and Inflatable Booth are better on the ground floor or with a lift, so we will recommend a booth that suits the access.

faqs.q: Is there an extra charge for travel to Wellingborough, Rushden or Raunds?
faqs.a: Delivery and setup are included; if any travel contribution ever applies to a far-flung venue it is shown on the quote up front. Wellingborough and the nearby towns, including Rushden, Higham Ferrers, Irthlingborough, Finedon, Raunds and Earls Barton, are all part of our regular coverage.

faqs.q: Our barn wedding is outside Earls Barton with limited power. Will a booth work?
faqs.a: Very likely. Every booth except the Inflatable runs from one standard socket, and our attendant tapes down any extension leads safely. Send us a photo of the barn's power points and a rough layout, and we will suggest where the booth should go and which model suits the space.

faqs.q: Can you put the school crest on prom prints in Wellingborough and Rushden?
faqs.a: Yes. Every booking includes a custom print template, so we can add the school crest, the year group and the date of the prom. Send the artwork when you book and we will share a proof for the school to approve, then agree a finish time that fits the evening's timetable.
